a.lede: Focus more on what matters, please, like creating useful software and accomplishing company goals
a.title: Amazon tells tokenmaxxing devs to slow their AI roll

b.lede: Amazon has published new engineering guidelines warning developers and managers against ‘tokenmaxxing,’ arguing that AI usage metrics are ‘deeply flawed’ unless tied to long-term outcomes. The move follows similar spending concerns at Uber and Accenture.
b.title: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
